# Kling AI
> Next-Generation AI Video & AI Image Generator Platform - Create professional videos and images with state-of-the-art generative AI technology

## Advanced Features
- [Kling AI Home](/app) - Explore featured AI tools, updates, and inspiration.
- [Creation Plugin Guide](/app/plugin-guide/creation) - Install and use Kling AI plugins in Photoshop, Figma, Premiere Pro, and After Effects.
- [Model Plugin Guide](/app/plugin-guide/model) - Install and use Kling AI plugins in Blender, Maya, and 3ds Max.
- [Effects Templates](/app/effects-template) - Browse reusable AI animation and visual effects presets.

## Collaboration
- [Activity Zone](/app/activity-zone) - Join community challenges and collaborative creative events.
- [Director Plan](/app/director-plan) - Collaborate with directors on cinematic AI storytelling.
- [Invitations Center](/app/invitation) - Manage invitations for collaborators and enterprise clients.
- [Creator Application](/app/creator-apply) - Submit your profile to become an official creator.
- [Creator Share](/app/creator-share) - Share your creatives to earn credits.

## Membership & Services
- [Subscription Guide](/app/subscribing) - Learn how plans, renewals, and billing work.
- [Commission Sharing](/app/commission-share) - Understand revenue splits for collaborative creator projects.

## Core AI Tools
- [Image Editing Suite](/app/image-edit) - Edit, expand, or refine images with precision.

## Developments
- [Kling AI](/dev) - Kling AI, tools for creating imaginative images and videos, based on state-of-art generative AI methods.

## ReleaseNotes
- [历史版本](/release-note/release-history) - Release Notes,Version Management,Changelog,Software Updates,Product Updates

          (function() {
          try{
            
            var cookieMap = document.cookie.split(';').reduce(function(map, cookie) {
              var trimmedCookie = cookie.trim();
              var separatorIndex = trimmedCookie.indexOf('=');
              if (separatorIndex > -1) {
                map[trimmedCookie.slice(0, separatorIndex)] = trimmedCookie.slice(separatorIndex + 1);
              }
              return map;
            }, {});

            var generateDid = function() {
                var timestamp = Date.now();
                var random5Digits = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100000) + 100000;
                var timeComponent = (random5Digits * 10000000000000 + timestamp).toString(36).slice(0, 12);
                var randomComponent = Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 12);
                while (randomComponent.length < 12) {
                    randomComponent += Math.floor(Math.random() * 36).toString(36);
                }
                var deviceInfo = [ navigator.userAgent, navigator.language, navigator.platform, navigator.vendor, screen.width, screen.height, screen.colorDepth, screen.pixelDepth, window.devicePixelRatio ].join('')
                var hashCode = (str) => {
                    str = str + Math.random().toString()
                    let hash = 0;
                    for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
                        var char = str.charCodeAt(i);
                        hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + char;
                        hash = hash & hash;
                    }
                    let hashStr = Math.abs(hash).toString(36);
                    while (hashStr.length < 12) {
                        hashStr += Math.floor(Math.random() * 36).toString(36);
                    }
                    return hashStr;
                };
                var deviceInfoHash = hashCode(deviceInfo);
                return 'web_' + timeComponent + randomComponent + deviceInfoHash;
            };
            var did = cookieMap.did || cookieMap._did || cookieMap.weblogger_did || generateDid();

          }
